mentions.name: TryCatchUp
mentions.description: TryCatchUp is a Slack app that sits in project channels and monitors them for early signs of trouble: it flags blockers, delays, and scope creep, DMs the project lead when something needs attention, and sends a Friday digest covering decisions, blockers, accomplishments, and recent activity. It keeps a pinned Canvas updated so stakeholders can check status without asking in-thread, stays quiet when a channel is active and does lightweight check-ins when it goes quiet, and deactivates itself if a channel has been dead for 3+ weeks (warns first, waits 7 days, then removes itself). Free tier covers 2 channels with weekly digests; Pro is $29/mo.
mentions.problem: Slack project channels can look fine until they aren't — real signal is buried in threads, stray blocker mentions, and a drop in channel activity, and someone ends up piecing status together by hand.
mentions.audience: Project leads and stakeholders working in Slack project channels
mentions.author: stevenmays
